newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia announces seven-point economic action plan.
newsitem.headline: Russia announces seven-point economic action plan.

text.p: Here are the seven points of a Russian government programme aimed at reviving the country's battered economy, to which President Boris Yeltsin gave his backing on Monday.
-- Paying off debts owed to public sector workers.
-- Targeting real help to those who really need it.
-- Securing a rise in industrial production and reviving agriculture through cheap credits.
-- Supporting local initiatives from the centre.
-- Cutting away at the roots of corruption, tightening control of state officials.
-- Teaching the state to live honestly, within its means, reducing the size of the state bureaucracy.
-- Honestly and openly explaining to citizens the actions of the government.
